description: Header file defining classes related to audio recording tracks in Android's AudioFlinger service, including RecordTrack, PatchRecord, and PassthruPatchRecord, with methods for managing audio capture, buffers, and synchronization.

classes.name: RecordTrack
classes.description: Represents an audio recording track, managing capture, buffers, and synchronization.

classes.name: PatchRecord
classes.description: A patch-based implementation of a recording track, used for patch panel audio routing.

classes.name: PassthruPatchRecord
classes.description: A specialized PatchRecord that passes through data directly from HAL.

methods.name: RecordTrack
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a recording track with parameters like thread, client, attributes, format, buffer, etc.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts audio capture with synchronization event.

methods.name: setOverflow
methods.description: Sets buffer overflow flag and returns previous state.

methods.name: updateTrackFrameInfo
methods.description: Updates frame info for the track.

methods.name: checkServerLatencySupported
methods.description: Checks if server latency is supported for given format and flags.
